relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — REPORT LOUDLY, and note this is the SECOND file in this slice mis-joined to 'wald1984' (the other is library/arxiv-1910.09966v1/1910.09966v1.pdf). The registered entry under that id is a general-relativity textbook that is not on arXiv. The attached file is a three-author hep-th arXiv preprint, id 9306069v2, on the stretched horizon and black-hole complementarity. No matching id exists in folio/schema/references.ts, so id is set to null. RELEVANCE: it introduces three postulates on black-hole evolution, develops a stretched-horizon/membrane description worked out in 1+1 dilaton gravity, and advocates black-hole complementarity. QOU's nearest content is conj:lqg-entropy-qdim-partition-pole in gravity-spacetime and the information-theory quantum-entropy blocks, but those turn on the LQG area spectrum and on categorical entropy, not on horizon complementarity or membrane dissipation; I found no QOU claim this document would support. Scope-(a): this document, as read, supplies nothing this folio can consume — not a claim that horizon thermodynamics is irrelevant to the framework. NOTE ON THE 'wald1984' ID ITSELF: with both of its seeded source files now shown to be other works, that id has no source anywhere in uploads/, and its two Lean citations are unverifiable as written — lean/QOU/MathlibExt/MonoidalCalcVar.lean:41 cites it at 'Theorem 4.3.1', a locator I could not confirm corresponds to a numbered theorem in the cited section of that book, and lean/QOU/QuantumObservableUniverse/GaugeTheory.lean:197 cites it bare.
